units.source_text: “有的人家，父亲年迈肥蠢，兄长面目可憎。

en.t: In some families, the father is old, fat, and foolish, and the elder brother has a hateful face.

units.source_text: 由此推察，这人家的女儿必不足道；

en.t: Judging from this, one would assume that the daughter of such a family must be nothing worth mentioning;

units.source_text: 岂知闺中竟有绰约娇姿，其人举止行动亦颇有风韵，

en.t: yet who would have thought that within the women's quarters there might be a graceful and lovely figure, whose movements and bearing also possess considerable charm,

units.source_text: 虽然只是小有才艺，实在出人意外，不得不使人深感兴味。

en.t: and although she has only a modest measure of talent and accomplishments, she is so unexpected that one cannot help feeling deeply intrigued.

units.source_text: 这种人比较起绝色无疵的佳人来，自然望尘莫及。

en.t: Compared with a peerless beauty without the slightest flaw, such a woman naturally cannot hope to come close.

units.source_text: 然而这环境中有这样的人，真教人舍不得啊！”

en.t: And yet, to find such a person in these surroundings truly makes one reluctant to let her go!"
